task.title: WI created by IPOC — Claim cancelled in the new region

step.cmd: Determine if a registration number is on file for the change of address issue:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 4.

If no, select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and assign one as follows:
Action: Select Assign .
Claim Source: Select 3 - Mail/Revised Decision .
Service Unit: Select 1 .
Decision Type: Select 3 - Revised .
Select Update .
Go to step 4.

step.cmd: Select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the appropriate registration number.
Memo (MPS): Check the box.
Detection: Select 31 - Other new facts - entitlement review .
Infraction: Select D - Non-fraud - Duplicate payment .
Message: Select 21 - An overpayment resulted due to being paid twice for the same period .
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select D - No to leave the registration number open for subsequent transactions.
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: BPC: Select the BPC of the claim that is converted to MPS.
Work item: Select 92 - Purge and recreate .
Work type: Select 27 - Claim transfer .
Remarks line 1: Type “Change of address as of [date]. Active BPC in both regions.”
Remarks line 2: Type “BPC in w/c [XXXX] to be retained in the old region. BPC in w/c [XXXX] to be cancelled in the new region.”
Remarks line 3: Type “Modify BPC in w/c [XXXX] to CS 8 for the new region and remove the weeks paid from the pay history summary.”
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 1 - No .
Complete: Select C - Yes to clear the registration number.
Select Update .

step.cmd: Select the Registration Number (M025, M030, M035) transaction and transfer the registration number to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Action: Select Change registration flag .
Registration flag: Select 4 - Insurance Payment Operational Centre .
Select Update .

step.cmd: Determine if an OP was created as a result of the claim cancellation:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 8.
If no, go to step 10.

step.cmd: In ACS, determine if the D-01-00-00 letter was sent for the change of address issue:

ul.li: If no, go to step 9.
If yes, go to step 10.

step.cmd: Create and send the D-01-00-00 letter. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
Disentitlement (2976)
D5, D12, D13, D14, D15 (3011)
D14 - Claim cancelled - Various reasons (3019)
BPC date - Sunday’s date (1060): Select the Sunday of the week the 14 - Void benefit period disentitlement (D14) was imposed.
D14 - Text: Type “You have received payments to which you were not entitled as a result of having a duplicate claim in another region.”

step.cmd: In NWS, complete the AI Transfer WI.
